messages:
lina-cs: BlueHarbor reached out — they want to swap billing entity to "BlueHarbor EU Ltd" and move contract terms from Net45 -> Net30 for the upcoming renewal. Procurement says they need a vendor code and PO before we can finalize. Can finance/legal confirm we can accept the EU entity for invoicing?
aditya-salesops: Thanks — can you paste the quote/contract id?
lina-cs: Quote: Q-89234. They want effective date 2026-06-01. Customer indicated PO will be: PO-2026-673 (pending vendor code).
olivia-finance: We need the EU VAT ID + remit address to create the vendor. Also confirm payment method (ACH vs wire). We'll need completed tax docs (W8/W9 equivalent).
kevin-legal: Any commercial redlines or data locality asks? If it's only party name + payment terms we should be fine, but legal needs the final signature block updated to the new party name.
lina-cs: No data changes. They requested the signature party name swap in the DocuSign. I've attached the requested signature page in the ticket.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 0x9a7b created and sent to primary signer (cfo@blueharbor.eu). Status: Sent. Link: https://docusign.internal/0x9a7b
aditya-salesops: Procurement won't approve PO release without vendor code. Who on our side handles vendor creation?
olivia-finance: Finance creates vendor records but we can't proceed without VAT + tax cert. CS should collect those. We'll start vendor onboarding once docs are uploaded.
kevin-legal: Also ensure the signatory's name on the DocuSign matches the vendor record. If CFO signs, good — if it's an individual distributor we may need a signature authority confirmation.
marcus-revops: Quick flag from revenue ops — changing billing entity midterm affects recognition mapping. If we do a split invoice (May to US entity, June+ to EU), routing and AR need clear notes. Approve interim split only with documented plan.
tom-csm: Lina — can you confirm whether PO is definitely arriving by EOB Friday? Procurement insists on timeline.
lina-cs: I'm chasing them. They said they'd aim for EOB Fri but might slip to next week. If PO delayed, are we ok issuing an interim invoice to the current US entity for May?
olivia-finance: We can issue an interim invoice to the US entity for May and switch going forward, but revenue ops approval required (see @marcus-revops). We'll also need the vendor creation to complete before the EU invoices run.
aditya-salesops: Noted. I'll coordinate on the billing plan once PO/VAT arrive.
kevin-legal: Once DocuSign is completed I'll review the executed copy to ensure the party name is correct. If everything matches, legal signoff is quick.
docusign-bot: Envelope 0x9a7b completed — signed by cfo@blueharbor.eu at 2026-06-03T14:12:45Z. Audit log attached.
lina-cs: Great — I'm pulling VAT ID now, will upload to the vendor form and push for PO. Will update here when PO lands.
tom-csm: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — staying on top of this.
